description: This file defines the FileManager class for handling file operations such as fetching, saving, and tracking files within the Excalidraw application. It includes methods for encoding files for upload and updating image statuses based on errors.

classes.name: FileManager
classes.description: Manages file fetching, saving, tracking, and status updates within the Excalidraw application.

methods.name: isFileTracked
methods.description: Checks if a file is being fetched, saved, or has errored.

methods.name: isFileSavedOrBeingSaved
methods.description: Determines if a file is either saved or currently being saved.

methods.name: getFileVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the version number of a file, defaulting to 1 if undefined.

methods.name: saveFiles
methods.description: Saves specified elements and files, updating internal tracking maps.

methods.name: getFiles
methods.description: Fetches files by IDs, updating internal state accordingly.

methods.name: shouldPreventUnload
methods.description: Determines if unload should be prevented based on files being saved.

methods.name: shouldUpdateImageElementStatus
methods.description: Checks if an image element's status needs updating based on saved files.
